alternatives.evidence: Kosovo industrial bakery, founded May 2012 and baking in the Fushë Kosovë industrial zone to ISO and HACCP certification, using German (Schneider) process expertise; its own catalogue lists 19 breads — Bukë Shtëpie me Fara, Volkanbrot, Spelt Dinkelbrot, Ciabatta Integrale, Bukë Malësie, Bukë me Arra, Bukë Dietale, Bukë XL — plus baguettes and pastries.

entries.note: READ BEFORE KEEPING THIS ROW. Buka Bakery is the manufacturing arm of Kosovo's Meridian corporation — its own About page says so in as many words ("Në Meridian veçse u vendos të krijohet dega më e re e Korporatës, e cila do të merrej me artin e prodhimit"). Meridian itself was rejected in an earlier pass as a retailer/importer, i.e. "sold in Kosovo is not made in Kosovo". Buka is the opposite case: a bakery with its own plant in Fushë Kosovë, its own certifications and its own bread range, so it satisfies the Kosovar-producer rule on its own site. It is named here explicitly so the Meridian link is visible and this one row can be deleted if the owner still wants nothing Meridian-related. The alternative to keeping it is an empty bread shelf: Ko-Bake sh.p.k. genuinely makes packaged Kosovar bread (Bukë Thekre / Bukë Dietale 500 g, barcode prefix 3902355) but has no live website at all, and Premium Bakery (premiumbakery.net) is in maintenance mode.

nonLocalBrands.company: Kellanova (cereals outside North America) / WK Kellogg Co (North America)
nonLocalBrands.evidence: "Kellanova, formerly known as the Kellogg Company, is an American multinational corporation, owned by Mars Inc." Headquarters: Chicago, Illinois, United States. The North-American cereal business is WK Kellogg Co of Battle Creek, Michigan (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/WK_Kellogg_Co). Neither is a Kosovar or Albanian producer.
nonLocalBrands.whyListed: A Kellogg's corn-flakes pack carrying Kosovo GS1 prefix 390 (barcode 3904933060414) was being admitted by the local-candidate gate on the strength of that prefix alone, and offered as the local alternative to a Serbian breakfast cereal. The prefix identifies the organisation that registered the number, not the brand owner -- this file's own disclaimer says so.

nonLocalBrands.evidence: "Top Budget est la marque premier prix d'Intermarche." "Intermarche est une enseigne francaise de grande distribution du Groupement Mousquetaires", head office Paris, France.
nonLocalBrands.whyListed: A French retailer's own-label line, admitted by the same prefix-only route as Kellogg's. A private label of a French supermarket group is not a Kosovar or Albanian brand.

nonLocalBrands.company: British American Tobacco (Modern Oral; the brand descends from Swedish Match/Epok)
nonLocalBrands.evidence: Velo is BAT's nicotine-pouch line, sold under BAT's New Categories/Modern Oral division; BAT is a British multinational headquartered in London. The pouches for the European market are manufactured in Scandinavia, not in Albania or Kosovo.
nonLocalBrands.whyListed: Owner report, 2026-09-16: "Velo Bright Spearmint ... Shqiperi ... vendore ... barkodi 5301000730801 this product not albanian". 95 Velo rows are in the catalogue; those on Albanian GS1 prefix 530 were marked isLocalBrand:true on the strength of the prefix alone and badged VENDORE. Note the same product line also appears on prefix 531 (North Macedonia), which is the proof that the prefix tracks the registering distributor, not the producer. The rows carry brand:null, so the non-local gate had to learn to read the product name.
